title: Besicovitch covering estimate: μ(A) ≤ C·t·ν(thickening(ρ₀, A)) when every x ∈ A carries a closed ball of radius in (0, ρ₀) with μ ≤ t·ν (parent steps 1–2)
statement: For every N ∈ ℕ there is C ∈ ℕ (depending only on N) such that the following holds. Let μ and ν be measures on ℝ^N = Euclidean N, let A ⊆ ℝ^N be an arbitrary set, ρ₀ ∈ ℝ and t ∈ [0,∞]. Suppose every x ∈ A has some σ ∈ ℝ with 0 < σ < ρ₀ and μ(B_σ(x)) ≤ t·ν(B_σ(x)), where B_σ(x) = closedBall x σ. Then μ(A) ≤ C·t·ν(thickening(ρ₀, A)) in [0,∞]. Here μ(A) is the outer measure, and thickening(ρ₀, A) = {y : infEdist(y, A) < ofReal(ρ₀)} (Metric.thickening).
lean_statement: ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (μ ν : Measure (Euclidean N)) (A : Set (Euclidean N)) (ρ₀ : ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ σ < ρ₀ ∧ μ (closedBall x σ) ≤ t * ν (closedBall x σ)) → μ A ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * t * ν (thickening ρ₀ A)
